pr_title: tests: dma: update test logic for unsupported dma suspend
pr_body:
Update test_loop_suspend_resume to avoid unnecessary status
check for those who do not support dma suspend.

Fixes #44006 
Signed-off-by: Guo Lixin <lixinx.guo@intel.com>
pr_comments: I've updated the way suspend/resume works in another PR #43984  and will make sure I account for this logic there
SInce #43984 refines the test logic, I will close this PR.
